welcome.title: Welcome to Satella
welcome.intro: Satella keeps your portfolio, custodians, and credentials in one local Vault on this computer. Financial data stays local except when Satella talks directly to Connectors and market-data sources you configure.
welcome.encryptionNote: Encryption protects copied files while the Vault is closed. It does not protect an open Vault from malware, administrators, or memory inspection.

password.title: Create a Vault password
password.minLengthError: Vault password must be at least {{min}} characters.
password.mismatchError: Vault password and confirmation do not match.

pin.title: Create a Screen-lock PIN
pin.description: Lock hides the interface behind this four-digit PIN while the Vault stays open. Background Refresh may continue. Lock is not Vault encryption.
pin.formatError: Screen-lock PIN must be exactly four digits.
pin.mismatchError: Screen-lock PIN and confirmation do not match.

preferences.title: Language and currency
preferences.description: Choose the interface language and the currency used for your portfolio totals. You can change both later in Settings.
preferences.languageHelper: Amounts and dates follow this language.
preferences.reportingCurrencyHelper: Portfolio totals, history, and allocation use this currency.

firstAsset.title: Add your first asset
firstAsset.description: You can start with the same Add assets flow you will use later, or skip.

pinConfirm.title: Confirm your Screen-lock PIN
pinConfirm.mismatchError: Screen-lock PINs do not match. Start again.
